quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: What does NOT affect how far a vehicle needs to travel to stop?

options.text: Your vehicle's tire condition and type.

questions.correctAnswerText: The time of day.
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition and type, road conditions, and speed.

questions.question: If you have no disabled person in your vehicle, can you park in a disabled parking space?

options.text: No, but you can stop in an emergency.
No, but you can stand there in an emergency.
No, you cannot park, stop, or stand there.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, you cannot park, stop, or stand there.
questions.explanation: You cannot stop, stand, or park in a disabled space unless your vehicle has a disabled plate or permit and the registered person is in the vehicle.

questions.question: You approach a railroad crossing with no flashing lights or gates. What should you do?

options.text: Be ready to yield to any train.
Speed up to cross before a train.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to yield to any train.
questions.explanation: Always be ready to yield to trains at railroad crossings, especially when there are no lights or gates. Do not cross until your entire vehicle can fit on the other side. Do not shift gears while crossing because your vehicle may stall.

questions.question: Two vehicles enter an intersection from different roads at the same time. Who must yield?
questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left
questions.explanation: At any intersection, if two vehicles arrive at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: You are in the middle lane of a three-lane highway. A car passes you on the right. Is this allowed?

options.text: No, because you must always pass on the left.
No, because they are passing in your blind spot.
Yes, if no signs forbid passing on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, if no signs forbid passing on the right.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes in the same direction, you can pass on the right as long as signs do not forbid it and the road is not blocked by parked cars or obstacles.

questions.question: What is a speed limit?

options.text: The maximum or minimum legal speed under dangerous conditions.
The maximum or minimum legal speed under ideal conditions.
The suggested speed under ideal conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum or minimum legal speed under ideal conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit is the maximum or minimum legal speed under ideal conditions. You can drive slower than the limit, but you cannot drive faster. Drive slower in school zones, work zones, or bad weather.

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as:
questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign.
questions.explanation: A red flashing light means stop completely. Look both ways and proceed when safe. A stop sign may also be posted at this location.

questions.question: When can you NOT cross a single broken white or yellow line?

options.text: When it would interfere with traffic.
When turning left into a driveway.
When the car in front is broken down.
When passing on the right on a one-way street.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it would interfere with traffic.
questions.explanation: You can cross a single broken line to pass or change lanes if you can do so safely without interfering with other traffic.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Yield to all traffic before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and cross carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light tells you to slow down to a safe speed and proceed with caution.

questions.question: Which traffic light means you must stop, yield to traffic and pedestrians, then go when safe?
questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing red light.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign indicates that:

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: When you see this sign, it means:

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. In this case, the road curves left. You may see several chevron signs through a curve.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. This hand signal means the driver plans to:
questions.correctAnswerText: Turn right.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: The safest speed to drive your car:

options.text: Is lower than the posted speed limit.
Depends on the weather and road conditions.
Depends on the mechanical skill of the driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: Depends on the weather and road conditions.
questions.explanation: In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted speed limit. You can get a ticket for driving too fast for conditions, even if you are below the speed limit.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. This hand signal means the driver plans to:
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, they are signaling a stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: When parallel parked, your vehicle may be no more than ____ from the curb.
questions.correctAnswerText: One foot
questions.explanation: When parallel parked, your vehicle should be no more than one foot from the curb. Make sure other parked vehicles have room to leave their spaces.

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes display arrows to control turns from specific lanes. A solid red arrow:

options.text: Is never used as a traffic signal.
Has the same meaning as a circular red traffic light.
Means that drivers may turn in the direction indicated by the arrow.
Means that the traffic the arrow is pointing toward must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Has the same meaning as a circular red traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same thing as a red traffic light. When an arrow is red, traffic in that lane must stop and cannot turn in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalks, a pedestrian should walk on the:

options.text: Side of the road which has the lightest traffic.
Same side of the road on which traffic is moving.
Side of the road facing oncoming traffic.
Side of the road which has the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Side of the road facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians should walk on the side facing oncoming traffic so they can see approaching vehicles.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. You should allow extra space for drivers to merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. You should allow extra space for drivers to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane. Check your mirrors and side, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a clear path.
